summary_request.confirm_write_title: Write a summary for this meeting?
summary_request.endpoint_external: The transcript is sent to an external service, which may bill for it.
summary_request.endpoint_local: The model runs on your own network.

audience.intro: Nextcloud Files controls who can read each recording.
audience.point_participants: Each recording is shared with all of the Talk room's participants, whether they were present on the call or not.
audience.point_attendees: Each recording is shared only with the people who were in the call while it was being recorded.
audience.point_moderators: Each recording is shared only with the Talk room's owner and moderators, whether they were on the call or not.
audience.point_mixed: Recordings here are not all shared with the same people: some with the whole Talk room, some with fewer people.
audience.point_guests: Guests without a Nextcloud account can't open it.
audience.point_no_reshare: Cassini never creates a public link, and the people who receive a recording cannot reshare the file.
audience.point_public_links: Cassini never creates a public link. In public rooms, people can reshare the file if this Nextcloud allows it.
